data.title: Meridian launches an automation apprenticeship
data.excerpt: A two-year programme pairing electrical, controls, and software apprentices with working engineers on live projects.
data.body:
Meridian has launched a two-year automation apprenticeship for early-career technicians and engineers. The programme combines structured training with supervised work on live automation and infrastructure projects.

Apprentices rotate through electrical, controls, and industrial software teams, with a mentor and a documented competency framework. The first cohort begins in the next academic cycle.

This announcement is illustrative portfolio content for the fictional Meridian brand.
